about.title: Connecting human potential with organizational purpose.
about.storyParagraph1: TIUM was established to solve a critical market disconnect: traditional staffing agencies prioritized transaction speed over candidate fit, delivering high candidate churn and costly hiring delays.
about.storyParagraph2: Headquartered in Austin, Texas, TIUM was built with a different philosophy: combining deep sector domain expertise, AI-driven talent mapping, and rigorous consultative vetting to deliver long-term organizational value.
about.missionDesc: To empower innovative enterprises with pre-screened, high-performing talent while elevating professional careers through purposeful placement.
about.visionDesc: To become North America's most trusted workforce advisory partner across mission-critical technology, engineering, and healthcare industries.
